items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I said, "Alon, who are you studying with?"

ctx.x: Right, Wendell. Now these are our children.

So now we come in the world with nothing; we go out with nothing. Wherever we could catch kids, instead of having a quart of whiskey on one arm and a chick on the other, we went and got these peoples and said, "Come on, it's out here." We couldn't play all 48 states. I said, "Alon, who are you studying with?" He had so many knots in his string we didn't know where to start, so we sent him to Mr. Gardner instead of George Stone. He has worked that thing out so marvelous to the fact that he can be an instructor and…

I want to ask you - when I came in which is around your time too, maybe a day or so before, the first great drummer that I had really heard that was exciting, like you, was a fellow named Kaiser Marshall. Do you remember Kaiser, Jo?
